title: Kia Canada 2026 EV4 brochure (PDF copy hosted on xr793.com) (third-party copy of the Kia Canada brochure)
notes: Kia Canada brochure text relayed on a third-party host (not kia.ca). Light FWD list: battery heating system, PTC heater, no heat pump. Wind FWD "adds to or upgrades from Light FWD": 81.4 kWh battery and heat pump. Wind Premium adds to Wind; GT-Line adds to Wind Premium. EV4 features an NACS charge port. Included portable charging cable (ICCB); on-board 11 kW.
